title: tools/check_typed_item_calls: check FT_BOOLEAN mask length
description:
This does output quite a few warnings.  Also note that
a problem with the re for matching items has been improved
resulting in many more masks being read than before.

Clearly incorrect mask values have been changed in ieee80211 and dhcp.

This check is only done if a new option, --mask-exact-match is given.
It is off by default.

Note that after these changes, 564 issues for FT_BOOLEAN mask widths
remain in the codebase of around 1600 dissectors.

notes.body: @realrichardsharpe - could you please check the wlan change in this MR?  It looks as though several masks were wrong - hopefully right now.

I'm not sure we want to enforce the leading zero format, i.e.:

```		      FT_UINT16, BASE_DEC, NULL, 0x07ff,```

I'm not really sure whether to enforce it either.  I do much prefer it.  This change as it is currently only warns about FT_BOOLEAN fields.  FT_BOOLEAN fields are often in an array of fields that all ought to be the same size, and I want to see the full masks in those cases.

What I might do is put this check behind another command-line arg that won't be set for pipelines (and will set it in my own script that runs various checks over 'my' private and public dissectors).  And still submit the dissector changes in this MR.  Does that sound reasonable to you?

This check is now only enabled through a command-line arg that pipelines don't set.

Note though that the remaining warnings represents around 1/3 issues per dissector, so most people already do pad the mask out if necessary to match the FT_BOOLEAN field width.

commits_data.message:
tools/check_typed_item_calls: check FT_BOOLEAN mask length

This does output quite a few warnings.  Also note that
a problem with the re for matching items has been improved
resulting in many more masks being read than before.

Clearly incorrect mask values have been changed in ieee80211 and dhcp.

This check is only done if a new option, --mask-exact-match is given.
It is off by default.

Note that after these changes, 564 issues for FT_BOOLEAN masks
remain in the codebase of around 1600 dissectors.wq
